description_en: Queries the trends of the scores on the security dashboard
description_zh: 查询安全大屏分数趋势
name: DescribeScreenScoreThread

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

>  The time range between the start timestamp and the end timestamp cannot exceed **seven** days
parameters.help_zh:
开始时间的时间戳。单位：毫秒。

> 开始时间戳和结束时间戳不能超过**7**天
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

>  The time range between the start timestamp and the end timestamp cannot exceed **seven** days
parameters.help_zh:
结束时间的时间戳。单位：毫秒。

> 开始时间戳和结束时间戳相差不能超过**7**天
parameters.name: end_time
